name.description: The component's name. This must be unique within the team and can only contain letters, digits, hyphens, underscores, and periods and can't exceed 60 characters.

content.description: The component's content, up to a maximum of 500 KB (UTF-8).

format.description: The component's content format. Defaults to YAML.

componentType.description: The component's type. Corresponds to the specification that the component's content adheres to.
componentType.title: componentType
